name: Bizzview – Quick View for WooCommerce
author: Saiful Islam

sections.description:
Doc | Get Premium | Try Live

Bizzview – Quick View for WooCommerce is a powerful addon that enables customers to quickly preview product details in a popup or sidebar without leaving the current page. This improves user experience, reduces bounce rates, and helps convert visitors into buyers.

😍 Free Features

  • Quick View Popup: A beautiful modal popup that displays complete product information — title, price, rating, description, images, and more — without leaving the current page. Improve user experience and reduce bounce rates instantly.
  • Sidebar View: An alternative sidebar layout for product details. Let customers browse products comfortably from a sleek side panel instead of a centered modal.
  • Multiple Modal Effects: Choose from 8 stunning animation effects — Fade, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Newspaper, Move Horizontal, Move From Top, 3D Unfold, and Slide Bottom — to match your store’s personality.
  • Gutenberg Block & Elementor Widget: The built-in Gutenberg block makes it easy to add quick view to any page. Elementor widget available for Elementor users. Build with your preferred page builder.
  • Shortcode Support: Place a quick view button anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode — [bizzview id="PRODUCT_ID"]. Works in pages, posts, and widgets.
  • Image Carousel: Beautiful Slick-powered image slider inside the popup with navigation arrows. Let shoppers swipe through all product images without opening the product page.
  • Variable Products Support: Full support for WooCommerce variable products. Customers can select variations (size, color, etc.) and add to cart — all within the popup.
  • Navigation Arrows: Next and Previous arrows let users browse through multiple products without closing and reopening the popup. Keeps shoppers engaged longer.
  • Add to Cart in Popup: Complete add to cart functionality built into the quick view. Customers can select quantity and add products to their cart directly from the popup.
  • Button Position Control: Choose from 6 different button positions on the product card — Above Title, Under Title, Under Rating, Under Price, Above Add to Cart, or Under Add to Cart.
  • Button Type Options: Display the quick view trigger as a standard button or a link — whichever fits your theme’s design better.
  • Auto Close on Add to Cart: Optionally auto-close the popup once the customer adds a product to the cart. Keeps the shopping flow clean and frictionless.
  • Perfect Scrollbar: Enable a beautiful custom scrollbar inside the popup for a more polished and premium look — especially useful for long product descriptions.
  • Responsive Design: Fully responsive and mobile-friendly. The quick view popup works perfectly on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
  • WPML Compatible: Works seamlessly with WPML and multilingual WordPress sites. Display product information in any language.
  • RTL Support: Full right-to-left language support. Works correctly for Arabic, Hebrew, Urdu, and other RTL languages.
  • jQuery Event Hook: Run your own JavaScript after the popup loads using $(document).on('bizzview_loaded', function() {}). Easily integrate with third-party scripts.
  • Multiple Action & Filter Hooks: Object-oriented code with multiple hooks and filters for developers to extend or customize any part of the plugin.
  • Lightweight & Optimized: Clean, well-structured codebase with minimal footprint. No unnecessary bloat — only what is needed loads on your pages.

⚡ Experience the Full Potential with Bizzview Premium

Get Premium | Try Live

  • Ajax Cart on Quick View: Add products to cart instantly via Ajax — no page reload, no redirect. Provides a seamless, one-click shopping experience for your customers. Works with both simple and variable products.
  • Category Restrictions: Show the quick view button only for products in specific categories. Perfect for stores where certain product types need different browsing experiences.
  • Elements Organiser: Drag and drop to reorder the elements shown inside the quick view popup — Title, Rating, Price, Excerpt, Add to Cart, Meta, Description, and Availability. Toggle each element on or off individually for a fully customized layout.
  • Popup Design Customization: Full control over the popup appearance — background color, inner padding, corner border radius, maximum width, overlay color, overlay opacity, close button color, and close button size.
  • Mini Cart Support: Enable quick view for products listed in the mini cart. Let customers preview products they have already added without navigating away.
  • Cart Page Support: Enable quick view for products displayed on the cart page. Customers can double-check product details before checkout.
  • Button Design Customization: Style every aspect of the quick view button — background color, text color, hover background and text color, border radius, font size, and horizontal and vertical padding.
  • Typography Controls: Customize the product title color, title font size, and price color to match your brand perfectly.
  • Gallery Lightbox: Full-screen image lightbox when customers click product images inside the popup. Includes zoom, arrow navigation, and thumbnail strip — coming soon.
  • Related Products in Popup: Show 2–4 related products at the bottom of the quick view popup. Configurable by category, tags, or custom selection. Boosts cross-sell opportunities — coming soon.
  • Wishlist Integration: Add a wishlist button inside the popup. Works with BizzWishlist, YITH Wishlist, WooCommerce Wishlist, and custom wishlist setups — coming soon.
  • Product Video Support: Display product videos from YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted sources directly in the image slider inside the popup — coming soon.
  • Social Sharing: Let customers share products from the popup on Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, or via WhatsApp — coming soon.
  • Variation Swatches: Replace plain dropdowns with beautiful color, image, and button-style swatches for variable product variations — coming soon.
  • Mobile Optimized Design: Separate design settings for mobile screens with touch-friendly navigation and swipe gestures for the image gallery — coming soon.

Shortcode

Use [bizzview id="PRODUCT_ID"] to manually add a quick view button anywhere.

Developer Friendly

  • Object-oriented code structure
  • Multiple action and filter hooks
  • Well-documented code
  • Extendable for custom features

Premium Features (Coming Soon)

  • Drag & drop content arrangement
  • Additional Modal Effects
  • Social sharing integration
  • Related products in popup
  • Custom fields support
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Go to ‘Quick View’ menu to configure settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

How do I add a quick view button manually?

Use the shortcode [bizzview id="99"] where 99 is your product ID.

Can I customize the button position?

Yes, you can choose from multiple positions: before title, after title, after rating, after price, before add to cart, or after add to cart.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, the quick view popup fully supports variable products with variation selection.

How can I run JavaScript after the popup loads?

Use the jQuery trigger: $(document).on('bizzview_loaded', function() { // your code });
